caption: The drawing consists of two horizontal decorative sections on a beige background. The upper section features a symmetrical arrangement with geometric and floral motifs in green and red. At the center is a vase-like shape with green and red horizontal bands and a circular base divided into green and white sections, surrounded by two red and green curved arcs that extend outward and upward. On either side of the central figure are star-like shapes with six petals (also green and red) and teardrop-shaped designs. The whole composition is framed above and below by alternating green and red rectangular blocks. The lower section features a repeating motif of six green leaf-like shapes, each surrounded by three small oval dots and two curved lines above and below, all rendered in green. The overall arrangement is organized and spaced evenly on the page.
title: Stencilled Wall Decoration
